movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. movies.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender

movies.tagline: One ring to rule them all.
movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

But he won’t do it alone: Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann are drawn back into another one of his perilous quests—assuming they can evade execution for aiding a pirate.
movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest

movies.tagline: It's not the armor that makes the hero, but the man inside.
movies.title: Iron Man 2
